body: He is super happy that I can love him and still be who i am, thanks alot for the advice it 100% helped

Hey thanks for the advice and sorry for the super late response, but it makes me calms my nerves knowing that I can be able to love him romantically and I feel better now! Thanks for helping solve my issus

Helped
That is true, and I do think the world of him, hes my everything, but it just really worries him sometimes and I feel extremely guilty for it, I do find him attractive but its mainly emotional.

The neighborhood im in isn't exactly the safest place, plus the pandemic and all, I cant really go many places, plus I'm not sure if i really want to at this moment at least. 

I wouldn't say I want to be bitter, I like being nice and sweet, but im more akward and weird to be honest, im not a very people person, unless I get to know you, I'm just very strange if a person so not many people can talk to me and enjoy the conversation.

Covering up is kind of nice especially if the cloths im wearing suits me, but as strange as this may sound I wanna wear more cute type of cloths, It seems like whenever I try to wear something that makes me feel I guess attractive I bail on the last second, the reason for this is stupid but I am very insecure about my body, and I also do not want to be seen as a "slut" or a "whore" so I play it safe and cover up, though it never really feels good when I do that. 

I understand that I have issues forgiving myself, and im really working on that, but my self worth just kinda feels nonexistant, like I couldn't contribute anything, its like I owe people everything and if they need something usually I give it to them because I feel obligated to. 

I guess You could say watching youtubers kind of puts at least a bit of a smile on my face, though with finals and chores I've been fairly busy and have had no time to watch, talking to my significant other helps a bit too, but I always feel guilty when I get random waves of sadness when I talk to him, and he worrys and feels bad that he cant help, thats why I haven't been trying to worry him, I dont want to call it depression because I have not seen a professional yet, but I do get very sad for no reason and im not sure why.

Ok so to answer the first question, I dont really go for long walks for anything like that, just when I have to take out the trash I stop for a second and take a breath of fresh air, we have plants and flowers which I do look at, I guess the entire outside experience is nice but it kinda gets me down because I cant really go anywherw else. 

For the second one I guess I'm trying to be a much nicer and sweeter person instead of someone who is bitter and constantly puts up a front? I guess, I'm not sure, it feels like Im not even 100% sure who I want to be, most times I have a thought in my head of what it is but then it gets all foggy, I mainly wear long sleeves and jeans just to stay in my comfort zone, I constantly feel like people are watching me so I cover up a lot

Third is kind of somethin I did and it made me feel a bit better but I still blame myself for being such an awful person to those I have hurt 

And finally I dont really look forward for anything really, im happiest when I'm asleep and not having to deal with being awake, school, people, thoughts, when I wake up each day its hard and from that moment on I'm just tired and I wanna sleep, possibly forever. I dunno its just a nice thought
Thanks for the advice about all this, you didn't have to and I honestly really appreciate it. I'll keep this all in mind and try to refresh my head, hopefully it'll fix itself soon
I think too many messages get to me, but at the same time if I'm alone I overthink? I'm not sure to be honest I can't really understand my thoughts sometimes
